strings.text: A Pier on a Mountain Lake
The water went still before the light went out.
strings.translation: 빛이 꺼지기 전에 물이 먼저 잠잠해졌다.

strings.text: The last light is slipping behind the ridge.
strings.translation: 마지막 빛이 능선 너머로 미끄러져 간다.

strings.text: The lantern was lit a little earlier than it needed to be.
The boat quietly tugs at its rope and goes still again.
strings.translation: 배가 가만히 밧줄을 당겼다가 다시 멎는다.
